description: This file declares functions, enums, and constants related to SSL/TLS cipher suite names, version strings, parsing cipher strings, and security assessments within the Chromium project. It provides interfaces for converting cipher suite numbers to strings, parsing cipher strings, and checking cipher suite suitability for HTTP/2.

methods.name: SSLCipherSuiteToStrings
methods.description: Converts a cipher suite number to its key exchange, cipher, and MAC string representations, along with flags indicating if it's an AEAD or TLS 1.3 cipher.

methods.name: SSLVersionToString
methods.description: Returns the string name of a given SSL protocol version.

methods.name: ParseSSLCipherString
methods.description: Parses a string literal representing an SSL/TLS cipher suite into its numeric code.

methods.name: ObsoleteSSLStatus
methods.description: Determines if a connection's SSL settings are considered obsolete based on security criteria.

methods.name: IsTLSCipherSuiteAllowedByHTTP2
methods.description: Checks if a cipher suite is permitted for use with HTTP/2.
